//: dashboard/dashboard.config.example.json -- copy to dashboard.config.json and edit.
//1: DOCS ONLY: the service never auto-loads a *.example.json file.
//2: Precedence PER KEY: CLI flag > RC_DASH_* env var > this file > built-in default.
//3: Omitted keys fall back to a built-in default that PROBES a candidate list.
//4: Run `uv run python -m rc_dashboard --print-config` to see what each key
//5: actually resolved to and why, and `--check-feeds` to see what is on disk.
//6: Every '//'-prefixed key is stripped by the loader, so comments are legal here.

feeds.//1: as log/ebpfm/<date>/<host>.jsonl -- the log/ebpfm symlink already ends in /logs.
feeds.//2: List every root to merge; a non-existent root is reported, never fatal.

ebpf.//3: max_age_s: residency_totals is written UNCONDITIONALLY every
ebpf.//4: EBPFM_RESIDENCY_S (default 60s) whether or not anything was tracked,
ebpf.//5: so freshness here means liveness, not activity. 300 = 5 ticks, the same

feeds.//7: Node tier (unprivileged): node_snapshot.py is a vendored copy of
feeds.//8: collect/common/snapshot.py, so log/login is schema-compatible and works
feeds.//9: as a stand-in before `ebpfm --node` is deployed anywhere.

ebpf_node.//10: 2 snapshots: per_user_cgroup.cpu_usage_usec is CUMULATIVE, so a per-user
ebpf_node.//11: CPU rate only exists as a delta between two consecutive snapshots.

feeds.//12: collect/slurm_query.bash writes ONE FILE PER DAY into DEST_DIR, named
feeds.//13: SlurmData_<start>_<stop>-orig.csv. Point `dir` at DEST_DIR, not at a file.
feeds.//14: NOTE: sacct -D --starttime/--endtime overlap at midnight, so a job spanning
feeds.//15: two days appears in BOTH day-files; the reducer dedups on JobID.

//16: The live window. 1440 min = 24h, matching the Overview grain, so the two
//17: tabs reconcile. A 24h window is served from per-minute BUCKETS, never from
//18: buffered raw events -- a day of records is ~10-20 GB fleet-wide.

live.//19: backfill_hours: 0 starts empty and fills forward, skipping the one
live.//20: expensive startup read. Progress is exposed on /api/feeds.

trajectories.//: 'usr' is excluded: a usr-keyed group is 'everything that user did',
trajectories.//1: which is not a trajectory. It is counted in by_key_type, never ranked.
